name: Superhuman Mail
description: Superhuman Mail lets agents search the inbox, read threads, draft replies, and look up calendar events in the signed-in Superhuman account. Drafts appear in Superhuman Mail for the user to review.

prompts.text: Summarize the unread emails from this morning that need a reply.
Find the latest thread with the design agency about the launch date.
Draft a reply to Anna that proposes a meeting on Thursday afternoon.

apps.name: Superhuman Mail
apps.description: Inbox search, thread reading, reply drafts, and calendar lookup, over Superhuman's MCP server with browser sign-in.
